query: SELECT a.choice, GREATEST(a.answered_at, COALESCE((SELECT max(h.answered_at) FROM intake.intake_answer h WHERE h.conversation_id = a.conversation_id AND h.question_id = 'heard'), a.answered_at)) AS "last!" FROM intake.intake_answer a JOIN intake.conversation c ON c.id = a.conversation_id WHERE c.homeowner_id = $1 AND a.question_id LIKE 'job.%' ORDER BY a.answered_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
